theoremName: undivided DAE graph and endpoint-flow collocation interval theorem

finitePolynomialUndividedFlowStatus.label: undivided graph and induced flow in the named polynomial collocation model
finitePolynomialUndividedFlowStatus.reason: Every graph and induced-flow collocation box has an outward-rounded Arb Krawczyk self-map, including the chart containing the zero of a8.

finitePolynomialEndpointRankStatus.label: restricted active endpoint map has full row rank in the polynomial collocation model
finitePolynomialEndpointRankStatus.reason: The interval endpoint matrix has a 2 by 2 minor whose Arb ball excludes zero.

exactEigenrowCoefficientCoverStatus.label: exact continuum coefficient field lies in the polynomial field balls
exactEigenrowCoefficientCoverStatus.reason: Requires a uniform between-node Bernstein/Cauchy enclosure for e^(q)(s), q<=8; pointwise node balls alone do not prove this inclusion.

exactCrossingContinuumPromotionStatus.label: exact continuum promotion through the simple endpoint crossing
exactCrossingContinuumPromotionStatus.reason: The exact derivative cover, singular inverse theorem, and concrete radii polynomial all close on the crossing interval.

exactContinuumPromotionStatus.label: exact Riemann-kernel undivided flow and endpoint rank
exactContinuumPromotionStatus.reason: The finite polynomial theorem and the exact singular-crossing promotion are closed. Full endpoint promotion still requires exact regular-piece propagation and certification of the restricted active endpoint minor.
